intelligence_summary: The evidence details enforcement operations and civil unrest involving the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), specifically Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Key personnel include BORTAC agents EZ-17 (Edgar Vazquez) and EZ-2 (Michael Sveum), as well as Bovino, a former Border Patrol Commander at Large who led immigration raids. Significant events occurred in Chicago, Illinois, between October 9 and October 27, 2025, involving protests and a Temporary Restraining Order (TRO), and in Minneapolis in early 2026, where a fatal shooting involving Renee Good took place. Agent Hewson was identified as being involved in the deployment of tear gas and pepper spray. Investigative efforts are being conducted by Bellingcat in collaboration with CalMatters, with Physicians for Human Rights (PHR) also noted as an involved organization.
investigation_summary: The investigation has mapped a network of 567 entities and 1,358 relationships, identifying a strong link between BORTAC agents (EZ-17 and EZ-2) and leadership figures like Bovino during immigration enforcement and crowd control operations. The most connected entity is Bellingcat, indicating a heavy reliance on open-source investigative research. The investigation has established a timeline of events spanning from October 2025 in Illinois to early 2026 in Minneapolis. However, the specific chain of command for the fatal shooting of Renee Good and the full extent of the use-of-force policy violations regarding 40MM launchers remains under scrutiny.
summary_text:
The evidence details enforcement operations and civil unrest involving the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), specifically Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Key personnel include BORTAC agents EZ-17 (Edgar Vazquez) and EZ-2 (Michael Sveum), as well as Bovino, a former Border Patrol Commander at Large who led immigration raids. Significant events occurred in Chicago, Illinois, between October 9 and October 27, 2025, involving protests and a Temporary Restraining Order (TRO), and in Minneapolis in early 2026, where a fatal shooting involving Renee Good took place. Agent Hewson was identified as being involved in the deployment of tear gas and pepper spray. Investigative efforts are being conducted by Bellingcat in collaboration with CalMatters, with Physicians for Human Rights (PHR) also noted as an involved organization.

The investigation has mapped a network of 567 entities and 1,358 relationships, identifying a strong link between BORTAC agents (EZ-17 and EZ-2) and leadership figures like Bovino during immigration enforcement and crowd control operations. The most connected entity is Bellingcat, indicating a heavy reliance on open-source investigative research. The investigation has established a timeline of events spanning from October 2025 in Illinois to early 2026 in Minneapolis. However, the specific chain of command for the fatal shooting of Renee Good and the full extent of the use-of-force policy violations regarding 40MM launchers remains under scrutiny.
